landa_1.m: Wha? You!? No, get away from me!
r: I heard that you saw something that you won't talk about.

landa_10.m: It was in the middle of the night, on the day before everything started. The day after, I was sleeping it off during the day, so I didn't notice all the turmoil about when they brought Hesor back.

landa_11.m: Almost the whole village wanted to see what had happened to Hesor. I kept to myself and didn't dare talk to anyone.

landa_12.m: The same day, others started to get pale as well. I could see it in their faces.

landa_13.m: The following night, I was getting ready to go to the well myself to look for any traces of what the boy had done.

landa_14.m: I peeked out the window to see if there was anyone that might see me. Instead, I saw someone skulking around the well, filling up several vials with both dirt around the well, and water from the well itself.

landa_15.m: I am sure it was Buceth, from the chapel. I have a good eye for people, and a good memory. Yes, I am sure it was Buceth.

landa_16.m: Also, isn't it strange how Buceth has not gotten ill, while all the others in the village have gotten ill?

landa_17.m: He must be up to something. He and that boy that looked like you. Are you sure it wasn't you?

landa_18.m: Never mind. Please don't tell anyone that I told you all this.

landa_19.m:
Now, get out of here kid, before anyone sees you talking to me.
[Looks around anxiously]
r: Thank you Landa. Your secret is safe with me.
Thank you Landa. I'll consider it.
Are you done? Phew, I thought you were never going to stop talking.

landa_3.m: You were there! I ssssaw you!

landa_4.m:
Or was it you? No, it looked like you, and I have a good memory!
[Bites lip]

landa_5.m: Get away from me, whatever you did over there, it's your business and I don't want any trouble!
r: You must have me confused with someone else.
Landa, you must have me confused with someone else! What was it you saw?

landa_7.m: No, you are smaller than him.
r: Are you going to tell me what it was you saw?

landa_8.m: The boy. He was doing something. I tried to sneak up closer to see what it was he was doing, I did. But he ran away before I could see.

landa_9.m: He did something by the well here in Loneford.

landa_already_1.m: You again? I already told you. Get out of here before anyone sees you talking to me.

loneford.10: I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown.
loneford.11: I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause.
loneford.21: The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City.
loneford.22: Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have.
loneford.23: Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow.
loneford.24: Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times.
loneford.25: I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone.
loneford.30: Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw?
loneford.31: Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village.
loneford.35: I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor.
loneford.41: I have bribed Buceth into talking to me.
loneford.42: I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow.
loneford.45: Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well.
loneford.50: I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford.
loneford.54: I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford.
loneford.55: Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further.
loneford.60: I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
